name: QNXMobility
tagline: A swerve-drive chair you steer by leaning, running on a real-time OS.

awards: QNX: Best Use of QNX: Hardware and Software Prizes

problem: The team had hub motors and wanted to rethink moving around a workspace without standing up.
solution: A swerve-drive base under a chair reads the rider's posture from an IMU: leaning sets direction and speed, controlled on a real-time OS.
demo_moment: Team-described: sit, lean forward and glide across the room.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “QNX: Best Use of QNX: Hardware and Software Prizes” among 261 submissions.
Built a rideable robot during the event.

lessons: A rideable demo is unforgettable; plan safety for the judging floor.
